steps.title: extends links two chains
steps.text: `class C__Sub extends C__Super` sets two links: instances fall back to `C__Super.prototype`, and the class itself falls back to `C__Super`. The first console line, `true`, checks the second link.
steps.textZh: `class C__Sub extends C__Super` 会建立两条链接：实例回退到 `C__Super.prototype`，类本身回退到 `C__Super`。控制台第一行的 `true` 检查的就是第二条。

steps.title: The old pattern links one
steps.text: `Sub.prototype = new Super()` links the instances, but `Sub` itself still falls back to `Function.prototype`, like any function. Those are the second and third console lines: `true`, then `false`.
steps.textZh: `Sub.prototype = new Super()` 连起了实例这一条，但 `Sub` 本身仍像普通函数一样回退到 `Function.prototype`。这就是控制台的第二、三行：先是 `true`，再是 `false`。

steps.title: Why static members are inherited
steps.titleZh: 静态成员为什么也会被继承
steps.text: A static member lives on the class itself. Give both parents a `create` helper: `C__Sub` finds it through the second link, while `Sub` has no such link and gets `undefined`.
steps.textZh: 静态成员放在类本身上。给两个父类都加一个 `create` 辅助方法：`C__Sub` 通过第二条链接找到它，而 `Sub` 没有这条链接，得到的是 `undefined`。

action.run: C__Super.create = () => 'made by C__Super.create'; Super.create = () => 'made by Super.create'; console.log('C__Sub.create():', C__Sub.create(), '| Sub.create:', Sub.create)

steps.actionLabel: Give both parents a static create()
steps.actionLabelZh: 给两个父类都加上静态 create()
steps.expectConsole: C__Sub.create(): made by C__Super.create | Sub.create: undefined
